content: 15:1-7 Mit big qob: wai sipsip qaar damorei
Qen geret munon gabmant qur baiau eng ne munon mindigar qob ten igour eng Yisas qob igotoub qamb diamirei.
Diab qob igub igamari Parisi ne qomon imbigau munon yurau eng der Yisast mindigar qob qamamir: “Munon eng munon qomon boru-boru ten igour eng wurinob bugab mi nub qib igo eng ge?”
Ende qamarari Yisas mi geret big qamar:
“An ger wai sipsip 100-ende igama gari qas magir qoa me gab mai gas ebet igo? Wo 99-ende oromar biua ai sirt wuri wogub gari qas qooiner end mom asi qibi mom gab wogub igo.
Gab eng ba igusub borusi mom mismisir igo.
Ende at ne ba mor irab wonou banamori eng ne munon banam eng oromar qamara yarari, “ye wai sipsip ger me gab asi qib igoum eng gab wogub yarari mismisirun” ende qamb igo.
Eng gas ende, munon 99-ende wot oabigunor eng wurinob igama ne bo gari qas qomon boru eng at qibi wogub misir uber igub oabig Qenu ginamt end iroa eng borusi mom mismisiriba.”
15:8-10 Mit big qob: nomon qur isa me geau

Ende qamb bo ger qamar: “yamangar ger nomon qur 10-ende (K1.00) igama bo gari qas isa wogub me gab eng mai gas ebet igo? Wo me gab eng urut uruguni wogub wonou munai eng gugum mom wab arir qibi gab baub qas wogub igo.
Baub ne wonou banamori ne munon banam oromar, “ye nomon qur isa me gab asi qib igoum eng gab baioum, yarari mismisirun” ende qemeriba.
Eng gas ende munon yurau aib erobon end gari qas Qenut oabiginer eng enger mot irab mismisirubour.”
15:11-32 Mit big qob: munon ger wau ombur igoai
Ende qamb imusi qamar: “Munon ger wau ombur igoai.
Ne wau yab eng der ur nob qamar, “Tain, ne mind bubur qerei yeis.” Ende qamara mind wonou wau ombur end wurit qereiamorei.
Qereima wau yab mind tau eng ne qur nob ba qen qei ubura ai pat gar qoorei. Iua end igo wonou yonou mai qamb qomon boru-boru end qur arir ugurei.
Ende at ne mind qei-qei eng gugum mom wurisab ugea ne qunumber qen aib ai end yara wo mi ger gab niau ue.
Ende gab ne wo qibi munon ger ai end gea ne imurima isub wonou bur youn aib eng qoat mi wurisab igoai.
Ende aba ne munon ger mi uta me niau. Borusi minemb wogub bur mi wurisa niari gongan eng ba nub igoai.
Ende at igoi wogub bugab misir igub qamar, “Yonou tainb mi ubub taui mi mian gab nub igour. Ye e meimet qamb minemb umb qib igoum?
End ne see qas ginam e wogub tain qani isub ete nob qemerin; tain ye Qenu ne nob magqurt qomon boru ebet qibi wogub yoroum.
End ne see bo yet “yonou wau” ende me yet qem. Qomon boru eng ebetem end ar sarau yet biga taui qamb ar sarau betet igoribam.”
Ende qamb ai eng wogub ur qani isib qamb der isorei. Isi yarab ginam isib bais mugenderi ende isub igama wonou ur asi gab borusi toubet wogub uyab-uyab isub bumani ambugeterei.
Ende aba wau der ur nob qamar: “Tain, ye Qenu ne nob ombur magqurt qomon boru ebet qibi wogub yoroum, end ne ne yonou wau qamb misir me igu.”
Ende qamara wonou sarau munon eng wurinob qamar: “Qand irab yonou mi goan degen eng ba yarab nagetet ne bunom tau eng ba yarab uben dirigar end ogumunimetet ne goten yau eng nagetet ende abar.
At ne bur qarig youn man end isub bur yeim uber eng gab waramb ba dearari yab nob nuboun.
Yonou wau e mom umorei bo me gunei qamb igoum e bo e yara gab borusi mismisir mi at nob nuboun.” Ende qamb ne mi arsiamirei.
Mi arsi nub sibem wab uru uyab toaubig igamari wau qamar man iuar eng qibi ginam pi diab toau igorei.
Igub mugenderi igo sarau munon ger wot ara isa qebi qamar, “Eng meimi ebet toaubig igour?”
Ende qamara sarau munon eng taui qamar, “Nonou ima mom iua umorei qamamin e bo yara gab mismisir toaubig igour.”
Wau qamar ende igub borusi oau biriberi nub wogub ur merimot wogub mor me iroau. Ende aba ur der wau qamar mor di qamb wot arei.

Ara diab ur nob agunub qamar, “Ne ge, togun qen e gugum ye ar sarau betet igumei. Ne mi geret qamara ye ger me nombarir igamau. Ende at igoum eng ne mi ger me yesau, ne wai meme yeim ger yesa ye arsi yonou sarau erogori baab igoun eng me wurinob nub igamau, sig ue ar.
Wein yab eng wo nonou mind biuar eng qarig ir qib wogub mi qorate biuar eng arir ugab wogub yara bo meimet qamb bur qarig waramb nob nub mismisir igoan?”
Ende qamara ur der wau qamar nob qamar, “Ne ye nob ginamt igoan. Eng yonomi eng nonou gor.
End ne nonou ima e segagam mom umorei qamamin eng bo init igub yara gab mismisir at igoun,” ende qamarei.
